hypothesis.statement: The mandated lever is spent and the cascade is REGISTER_ONLY by the predecessor's own stopping rule, so the next lane should not spend another probe on the r3/r7 exchange. The one region still carrying STRUCTURE is the case-2 init block, and this session re-derived its mechanism from the aligned view at zero build cost: the target keeps `off` as a live INTEGER index into pal and stores `@0x124 sthx r0,r25,r19` after seeding `@0xc0 addi r19,r29,0` (a copy of the live zero i, r29) and walking it `@0x12c addi r19,r19,2`; our build STRENGTH-REDUCES the same source into a walked pointer, seeding `@0xb0 addi r19,r25,0` (a copy of pal, r25) and storing `@0x124 sth r0,0(r19)`. Because the reduction eliminates i's only other consumer, our `li r29,0` also SINKS from the target's `@0xa8` to our `@0xd4`, which is what makes the block's five-word displacement look like a schedule question when it is one transform. The untried question is therefore not WHERE the words sit but WHAT DEFEATS THE INDUCTION-VARIABLE REDUCTION of `pal + off` while `off` stays an int -- axis 16 of the predecessor closed every spelling that kept `off` an int byte index, and axis 15 closed `((u16*)pal)[i]` on fuzzy, so the remaining class is a second CONSUMER of `off` (or of pal) that the reduction cannot eliminate.
